results.text: Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

[Section]
OUR PEOPLE / Employee Profile

[Content]
The Group understands that employees are important assets and its business development depends on their hard work. To attract and retain talent, we offer competitive remuneration and welfare packages that include annual leave, marriage leave, maternity leave and paternity leave. We provide overtime allowance, including monetary compensation or compensatory leave, standby allowance, and taxi allowance for employees who work extra hours. Medical insurance scheme is in place for employees to enjoy medical benefits. To promote employees to be vaccinated against covid-19, we provide employees with a day off on the day of vaccination.
